provenance.inclusionRule: Full npm ci dependency/dev/optional set on Linux x64, npm 10.9.9, Node 22.23.3; require every compatible locked package, including optional packages. Omit only exact lock os/cpu-incompatible optional locations and their explicitly optional descendants. Every optional Node engine has an independently checked sufficient >= branch or is unrestricted; no optional npm engine restriction. npm loads lock metadata and checks optional platform before extraction; this v3 lock has no libc fields, therefore both Linux x64 resvg variants are required despite published libc selectors. Published raw package.json bytes remain independently bound. No learned installed inventory or omitted-by-install-failure allowance.
provenance.binRule: One canonical relative POSIX symlink in owning node_modules/.bin per exact matching lock/published package declaration; collisions are refused. Identity only; target content hashes are observed stability, never independent expected bytes.
provenance.qualification: Independent expected metadata baseline; reviewer approval and actual observed comparison remain separate.
